about: The kit's global variables: every value the look is made of. Edit them from the catalog's Variables page (it saves here and regenerates tokens.css), or by hand followed by `npm run tokens`. Never edit tokens.css.

groups.label: Glass
groups.description: Windows, menus and bars let what is under them show through, blurred and tinted by the theme; the scrims behind a window blur the page. Cards, tables and panels of a page stay solid. Reduce transparency (KitAppearance, or the system's own wish) turns all of it off.

tokens.name: --kit-glass
tokens.label: Window opacity
tokens.description: How much of its own colour a glass surface keeps: dialogs, page windows, the drawer, menus, selects, pickers, tooltips.
tokens.why: lenzi, 2026-10-01: "un po' di trasparenza nelle finestre"; lowered twice (72%, then 64%) on 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-03: "abbassa ancor un po' l'opacità delle superfici in vetro".

tokens.name: --kit-glass-bar
tokens.label: Top bar opacity
tokens.description: The top bar and the snackbar keep a little more colour than windows, so their text stays readable over moving content.

tokens.name: --kit-glass-blur
tokens.label: Glass blur
tokens.description: How much a glass surface blurs what is under it.
tokens.why: substance-tracker, 2026-10-01, like Android 17's app menu and notification shade.

tokens.name: --kit-glass-saturate
tokens.label: Glass saturation
tokens.description: The colours seen through glass, a little more saturated (Acrylic's recipe).

tokens.name: --kit-scrim-blur
tokens.label: Scrim blur
tokens.description: How much the page behind an open dialog, page window or drawer is blurred.
tokens.why: lenzi, 2026-10-02: "metti il blur all'apertura di ogni pagina che sotto mostra il resto".

tokens.name: --kit-scrim-opacity
tokens.label: Scrim darkness
tokens.description: How dark the scrim behind a dialog is (the CDK's own 0.32).

groups.label: Borders
groups.description: Every surface that rises above the page has a border in outline-variant, and every rounded border has the same width. Straight dividers stay 1 px: they have no corners.

tokens.name: --kit-border
tokens.label: Border width
tokens.description: Every rounded border: cards, panels, dialogs, the drawer, outlined buttons, chips, text fields, toggles, tables, tooltips.
tokens.why: lenzi, 2026-10-02: "i bordi agli angoli non hanno lo stesso spessore dei lati DA NESSUNA PARTE". At 100% scale a 1 px border is smeared at half strength along a rounded corner; 2 px keeps a whole pixel on the curve. 1.5 px is no way out: Chrome rounds borders down to whole device pixels.

tokens.name: --kit-border-focus
tokens.label: Focused field border
tokens.description: A focused text field: one more than at rest, as in Material.

groups.label: Shape
groups.description: Corner radii and the distance of the floating bars from the screen's edges.

tokens.name: --kit-float-gap
tokens.label: Floating gap
tokens.description: The top bar and the drawer float this far from the screen's edges.
tokens.why: lenzi, 2026-10-02: "la barra in cima deve avere bordi arrotondati in entrambe le versioni"; the drawer "come la versione mobile quindi con i bordi arrotondati".

tokens.name: --kit-bar-radius
tokens.label: Bar radius
tokens.description: The top bar, the drawer and the info bars (Material 3's large shape).

tokens.name: --kit-panel-radius
tokens.label: Panel radius
tokens.description: Menus, selects, autocomplete panels and tables: rounded on every side, a few px away from their field.
tokens.why: lenzi, 2026-10-02: "la scelta nelle metrics non ha border radius".

tokens.name: --kit-option-radius
tokens.label: Option radius
tokens.description: The chosen, hovered or focused option inside a menu or select: a rounded pill a few px in from the panel's sides.

tokens.name: --kit-card-radius
tokens.label: Card radius
tokens.description: Standalone cards in the middle of a page (not found, blocking screens): Material 3's extra-large shape, like the dialogs.

tokens.name: --kit-widget-radius
tokens.label: Widget radius
tokens.description: The chart cards (KitWidgetCard): almost black, very round corners.

groups.label: Motion
groups.description: Windows never grow: they are full size from their first frame and rise into place while their content fades in. Every other panel that appears over the page rises the same way, less far. None of it with reduced motion.

tokens.name: --kit-window-rise
tokens.label: Window rise
tokens.description: How far a dialog or page window rises when it opens. The snackbar rises as far.
tokens.why: lenzi, 2026-10-02: "aggiungi animazione apertura"; a growing blurred surface stuttered ("sembra che lagga").

tokens.name: --kit-panel-rise
tokens.label: Panel rise
tokens.description: How far menus, selects, autocomplete and pickers rise when they open from their field or button.
tokens.why: lenzi, 2026-10-02: "La voglio su ogni pannello che appare in quel modo".

tokens.name: --kit-rise-duration
tokens.label: Rise duration
tokens.description: How long the rise of windows and panels lasts.

tokens.name: --kit-rise-easing
tokens.label: Rise easing
tokens.description: The curve of the rise: Material 3's emphasized decelerate.

tokens.name: --kit-window-exit
tokens.label: Window close fade
tokens.description: Closing, the whole window fades. Its content fades in over 250 ms when it opens (provideKit sets Material's dialog timing).
tokens.why: lenzi, 2026-10-02: windows open and close "poco più lente" than Material's 150 / 75 ms.

tokens.name: --kit-scrim-duration
tokens.label: Scrim fade
tokens.description: The scrim's tint and blur grow from nothing in this time (the CDK's own 400 ms).

tokens.name: --kit-standard-duration
tokens.label: Standard duration
tokens.description: Things that change in place: a segmented bar going from every segment to one, and back.

tokens.name: --kit-standard-easing
tokens.label: Standard easing
tokens.description: Material 3's standard curve, for changes in place.

groups.label: Sizes
groups.description: The sizes lenzi chose where Material's did not fit.

tokens.name: --kit-toggle-height
tokens.label: Toggle height
tokens.description: Every toggle group and pill toggle. Less tall never means less round.
tokens.why: lenzi, 2026-09-30: 48 px was "ciccio in altezza", then 36 ("ancora leggermente più piccole"), then 32.

tokens.name: --kit-toggle-padding
tokens.label: Toggle label padding
tokens.description: Room at each side of a toggle's label: lower toggles, no narrower ones.

tokens.name: --kit-pill-padding
tokens.label: Pill toggle padding
tokens.description: Room at each side of the word of a single pill toggle (KitPillToggle): a little less than a toggle group's, so the figure beside it fits on a phone.

tokens.name: --kit-search-height
tokens.label: Search bar height
tokens.description: Search bars are elongated circles, a little lower than a text field.
tokens.why: lenzi, 2026-09-30: "come la barra di Chrome … non quadrato con i bordi smussati".

tokens.name: --kit-fab-size
tokens.label: Add button size
tokens.description: The floating "+": a little larger than Material's 56 dp.

tokens.name: --kit-fab-icon
tokens.label: Add button icon
tokens.description: The "+" icon inside the add button.

tokens.name: --kit-drawer-width
tokens.label: Drawer width
tokens.description: The navigation drawer.

tokens.name: --kit-nav-gap
tokens.label: Drawer entries gap
tokens.description: A little air between the drawer's entries.
tokens.why: lenzi, 2026-10-03: "distanzia leggermente di più i bottoni nel menu laterale in altezza".

tokens.name: --kit-segment-height
tokens.label: Segmented bar height
tokens.description: The track of a segmented bar (KitSegmentedBar).

tokens.name: --kit-segment-min
tokens.label: Least segment width
tokens.description: A tiny segment (1 of 391) stays visible, also under the rounded corner.

tokens.name: --kit-segment-gap
tokens.label: Segment separator
tokens.description: The separator between two segments: the track's colour shows through.

tokens.name: --kit-dot-size
tokens.label: Identity dot
tokens.description: The small filled circle in an identity colour next to a name.

groups.label: Status colours
groups.description: The only colours that carry a meaning. A pair for the dark theme, about oklch 0.80 and 0.15 of chroma, both above 8:1 on the cards (Material's own green palette is neon).

tokens.name: --kit-status-good
tokens.label: Good
tokens.description: A change that went the good way (KitDelta).
tokens.why: lenzi, 2026-10-09: "the delta could be green if it's negative and red if it's positive".

tokens.name: --kit-status-bad
tokens.label: Bad
tokens.description: A change that went the bad way (KitDelta).

groups.label: Surfaces
groups.description: Material 3's neutral roles, overridden: violet on neutral greys, "like Obsidian". The page is anthracite, the cards of charts almost black, windows and menus lighter. The accent (Material's violet palette, cyan tertiary) comes from the theme mixin, not from here.

tokens.name: --mat-sys-background
tokens.label: Background
tokens.description: The page.
tokens.why: lenzi, 2026-10-02: "Come in foto, quindi viola/g scuro come obsidian".

tokens.name: --mat-sys-surface
tokens.label: Surface
tokens.description: The page, and Material's default surface (dialogs).

tokens.name: --mat-sys-surface-dim
tokens.label: Surface dim
tokens.description: Material's dim surface.

tokens.name: --mat-sys-surface-bright
tokens.label: Surface bright
tokens.description: Material's bright surface.

tokens.name: --mat-sys-surface-container-lowest
tokens.label: Container lowest
tokens.description: The almost black chart cards.

tokens.name: --mat-sys-surface-container-low
tokens.label: Container low
tokens.description: Standalone cards.

tokens.name: --mat-sys-surface-container
tokens.label: Container
tokens.description: Menus, selects, pickers.

tokens.name: --mat-sys-surface-container-high
tokens.label: Container high
tokens.description: Tooltips, lighter windows.

tokens.name: --mat-sys-surface-container-highest
tokens.label: Container highest
tokens.description: Tracks, neutral bars.

tokens.name: --mat-sys-surface-variant
tokens.label: Surface variant
tokens.description: Material's surface variant.

tokens.name: --mat-sys-on-background
tokens.label: On background
tokens.description: Text on the page.

tokens.name: --mat-sys-on-surface
tokens.label: On surface
tokens.description: Text and values.

tokens.name: --mat-sys-on-surface-variant
tokens.label: On surface variant
tokens.description: Secondary text: details, the word before a figure.

tokens.name: --mat-sys-outline
tokens.label: Outline
tokens.description: Notes (body-small in outline), neutral lines.

tokens.name: --mat-sys-outline-variant
tokens.label: Outline variant
tokens.description: Every border of a surface, the faint grid of charts.

tokens.name: --mat-sys-inverse-surface
tokens.label: Inverse surface
tokens.description: The snackbar.

tokens.name: --mat-sys-inverse-on-surface
tokens.label: Inverse on surface
tokens.description: Text on the snackbar.
